description: Lists all open sessions: sandboxes owned by this server (headless) plus attended workbooks open in VS Code. `info` already includes this — reach for `list_sessions` to RE-CHECK presence mid-task (has the user opened or closed something?) without paying for the full readiness report. A `attended` session means a user has that workbook open RIGHT NOW. Each entry has an id, kind (sandbox|attended), origin, whether a grid is showing it (view| headless), its file, and current head commit; session_ids route every other tool. Also lists RECENTLY CLOSED sessions — including a workbook the editor reopened under a new id, which is what to use when an id you were holding stops working. You rarely need to poll this: attended-session changes (the user opened, closed, or reloaded a workbook in the editor) are announced automatically at the top of your next tool result.
name: list_sessions
